options.name: allow_cleanup
options.description: A boolean that dictates if the resource instance should be deleted (cleaned up) during the processing of a region instance delete call.

options.name: entity_lock
options.description:
Indicates if the resource instance is locked for further update or delete operations.
It does not affect actions performed on child resources like aliases, bindings or keys. False by default.

options.name: location
options.description: The deployment location where the instance should be hosted.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the instance. Must be 180 characters or less and cannot include any special characters other than `(space) - . _ :`.

options.name: parameters
options.description: Configuration options represented as key-value pairs that are passed through to the target resource brokers.

options.name: plan
options.description: The unique ID of the plan associated with the offering. This value is provided by and stored in the global catalog.

options.name: recursive
options.description: Will delete resource bindings, keys and aliases associated with the instance.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: The ID of the resource group.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags that are attached to the instance after provisioning. These tags can be searched and managed through the Tagging API in IBM Cloud.
